summary: BStr's Debug implementation omitted ASCII control bytes 0x1a through 0x1f from its hexadecimal escape arm, causing them to fall through to escape_debug and print as Unicode escapes. The fix handles the complete 0x01..=0x7f range with escape_ascii. The fix also extends impls::test_debug with an assertion covering the omitted bytes. Reversing the implementation block restores the original behavior while preserving that assertion. No tests were executed.
expected_failure: assertion `left == right` failed: actual Debug output contains \u{1a}\u{1b}\u{1c}\u{1d}\u{1e}\u{1f} instead of the expected \x1a\x1b\x1c\x1d\x1e\x1f.
